description.content: Official real-time data API for the Unrivaled professional women's 3x3 basketball league, operated by Sportradar as the league's Official Data Provider. Feeds cover schedules, standings, rosters, real-time scores, play-by-play, injuries, transfers, and season statistics, in JSON or XML. Assembled by API Evangelist on 2026-07-21 from the per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions embedded in the 23 Unrivaled reference pages at https://developer.sportradar.com/basketball/reference/unrivaled-overview; operation content is preserved verbatim from the source definitions.
